intro: Keeper of the Flame is a quest offered by Captain Grayson, a spectral sailor haunting the rocky shores of the Westfall Lighthouse. In the wake of a brutal murloc massacre that wiped out the living keepers, Grayson seeks oil to keep the coastal beacon burning and guide ships safely past treacherous reefs.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The night the Lighthouse Keeper's family died was horrible. I watched, helpless, as Old Murk-Eye led the attack. But what's done is done and now my concern is for the lives of the sailors on The Great Sea whose ships come close to the perilous rocks of the coastline. With no one to keep watch on the flame the responsibility has fallen upon me.
Help me keep the torch lit by bringing me 5 flasks of oil from the Harvest Monsters.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The flame will not burn for long without oil, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Praise you, brave Shaman. The rocks of the Westfall Coast shall be lit thanks to your hard work. Many lives will be spared so long as the torch is kept lit.
I died needlessly on this very shore. My afterlife plight is to see that no others follow my destiny.
